frozenValueCheck: 17/17 quoted values identical to the audit

corrections.earlier_statement: LLM: provider openrouter, model google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it (assumed; LLM_PROVIDER is defined twice in apps/ai-orchestrator/.env)
corrections.verified_fact: The orchestrator's analysis and recommendation calls use LlamaProvider(settings.llm_base_url, settings.llm_model, …) only; the model recorded in all 19 llm_analyst results of the frozen database is 'vllm-spark-01/gemma4-26b-uncensored' on a self-hosted OpenAI-compatible vLLM endpoint; 'google/gemma' appears in none of them. OPENROUTER_* settings are not used on that path.
corrections.effect_on_numbers: none — no metric was computed from the provider name; only the description of the environment changes
corrections.how_verified: source read (apps/ai-orchestrator/src/api/routes/recommendations.py, agents/llm_analyst_agent/agent.py, config/settings.py) and a query of agent_results.output in soar_eval

terminology: Recommendation Compliance / Consistency, Evidence Coverage, Playbook Alignment, Policy Compliance, Workflow Completion, Verification Outcome, Recurrence Detection — never 'accuracy'; RESOLVED = the verification procedure did not detect the specified recurrence condition within the tested window (not proof of eradication).

conditions.real_wazuh: Clean Run v2 and Intervention Run v2 (frozen)
conditions.consistency: repeated recommendation generation on identical evidence (new)
conditions.negative: controlled invalid recommendations and governance gates (new)
conditions.previous_mock: NOT used anywhere in this file (kept separately in results/evaluation.json)

clean_run__among_evaluated.population: recommendations that passed the validator and were scored (Clean Run v2)
clean_run__among_evaluated.interpretation: Share of validated recommendations satisfying all six deterministic criteria (attack alignment, evidence support, knowledge validity, policy compliance, playbook alignment, approval correctness). Not accuracy.
clean_run__among_evaluated.limitation: 10 predefined test cases (9 evaluable; TC-05 needs a Windows endpoint that does not exist); one run per condition; not representative of all SOC situations. Cases that produced no valid recommendation (TC-03, TC-08) are outside this denominator.

clean_run__among_attempted.interpretation: Same numerator over every attempted case; a case with no valid recommendation counts as not compliant.
clean_run__among_attempted.limitation: 10 predefined test cases (9 evaluable; TC-05 needs a Windows endpoint that does not exist); one run per condition; not representative of all SOC situations.

intervention_run__among_evaluated.population: recommendations scored after analyst IOC correction (Intervention Run v2)
intervention_run__among_evaluated.interpretation: Compliance of an analyst-assisted condition; must be reported next to the Clean Run and never as unaided performance.
intervention_run__among_evaluated.limitation: 10 predefined test cases (9 evaluable; TC-05 needs a Windows endpoint that does not exist); one run per condition; not representative of all SOC situations. The analyst is a fixed script.

clean_run__per_attempted_case.interpretation: Cases whose recommendation has every step target evidence-backed (evidence-linked IOC, analyst-added IOC or affected host); cases without a validator-passing recommendation count as not covered.
clean_run__per_attempted_case.limitation: Membership test, not semantic: a step aimed at the endpoint's own IP (TC-07) is counted as covered. Per-recommendation coverage is 100% by construction of the validator and is not reported as a result.

intervention_run__per_attempted_case.interpretation: As above, after analyst IOC correction.
intervention_run__per_attempted_case.limitation: As above; obtained with analyst intervention.

clean_run.interpretation: Selected playbook equals the ground-truth playbook and every action is inside it.
clean_run.limitation: Measured after a PlaybookSelector tie-break defect (TC-09 chose PB-C2) was fixed; that defect and fix are disclosed in the main evaluation findings.

clean_run.interpretation: Step approval flag equals the Policy snapshot and a responsible role is present.
clean_run.limitation: Current Policy implementation is the source of truth; negative policy behaviour is covered separately in the negative validation.

clean_run.interpretation: All 11 workflow steps present in the database through a stored verification; does not mean RESOLVED.
clean_run.limitation: Incomplete cases: 2 without a valid recommendation, 2 whose re-hunt had no searchable IOC.

intervention_run.limitation: Incomplete cases: 2 whose re-hunt had no searchable IOC.

clean_run.population: cases with a recommendation (Clean Run v2)
clean_run.interpretation: T_recommendation − T_investigation_start, uninterrupted scripted run; includes third-party LLM latency.
clean_run.limitation: Excludes the two cases with no valid recommendation (right-censored); no human in the loop.

intervention_run.population: cases with a recommendation (Intervention Run v2)
intervention_run.interpretation: As above, including retry rounds and the analyst-correction step.

clean_run__from_vigix_ingest.interpretation: T_response_start − T_alert_received_by_VIGIX; includes LLM latency and a scripted SOC/IR step.
clean_run__from_vigix_ingest.limitation: Webhook (custom-vigix → backend) latency was not part of the evaluation path.

clean_run.interpretation: REHUNT_STARTED → verification stored (Wazuh Indexer query plus verification); total only.
clean_run.limitation: Query and processing time cannot be separated; small index; excludes the harness' indexer-refresh wait.

clean_run.interpretation: 0% by construction: no correction is allowed in a Clean Run; blocked cases are counted as failures instead.
clean_run.limitation: 10 predefined test cases (9 evaluable; TC-05 needs a Windows endpoint that does not exist); one run per condition; not representative of all SOC situations.

intervention_run.interpretation: Cases in which an analyst IOC correction was needed (TC-03 e-mail, TC-08 process/command).
intervention_run.limitation: The analyst is a fixed script, not a human judgement.

clean_run.interpretation: Cases with at least one failed generation call. Total retry count is a count, not a percentage.
clean_run.limitation: Retry counts of the two blocked cases are censored at the harness cap of 5.

clean_run.population: cases with a completed (simulated) response (Clean Run v2)
clean_run.interpretation: Outcome distribution of the real re-hunt. RESOLVED = the verification procedure did not detect the specified recurrence condition within the tested verification window. ERROR = the re-hunt could not run (no searchable IOC).
clean_run.limitation: Not proof of eradication or containment: responses were simulated, each attack ran once, and only IP/domain/URL/hash IOCs are searchable.

intervention_run.population: cases with a completed (simulated) response (Intervention Run v2)

control_tc01.population: single control: the TC-01 attack repeated after the simulated response
control_tc01.interpretation: The real re-hunt detected the recurring attacker IP (29 matching events) and returned NOT_RESOLVED; the incident stayed open and Investigation #2 was opened by Policy.
control_tc01.limitation: One positive control on one case and one IOC type; no negative control, no spread-detection test.

controlled_procedural_baseline.population: 9 evaluable cases, same alerts as the Clean Run
controlled_procedural_baseline.interpretation: Wall-clock duration of a deterministic, non-AI procedure (evidence collection from the Wazuh Indexer → alert-declared MITRE → playbook lookup → response plan). Same interval definition as VIGIX Investigation Time (investigation start → a proposed response is available), but different content: no LLM stage.
controlled_procedural_baseline.limitation: Machine procedure latency, NOT human analyst performance; must not be read as a real-world baseline or a speed-up claim.

controlled_procedural_baseline.interpretation: NOT MEASURED (NULL). The baseline has no approval workflow instance and no human participant; a decision latency would have to be invented.
controlled_procedural_baseline.limitation: No baseline decision latency exists; VIGIX Time-to-Decision (a scripted approval, ≈0.06 s) is therefore not compared with anything.
controlled_procedural_baseline.null_reason: no human or approval instance in the baseline; reaction time is not invented

overall_pooled.population: 6 cases × 5 repetitions on identical evidence snapshots (Clean Run v2 incidents)
overall_pooled.interpretation: Runs whose validated primary recommendation (same playbook, primary action, target type and target value) equals the modal one, over all runs. Not accuracy.
overall_pooled.limitation: Single LLM (vllm-spark-01/gemma4-26b-uncensored on a self-hosted vLLM server); representative cases only; 10 calls that failed because the LLM endpoint was unreachable (timeout / ConnectError) are excluded and listed; identical evidence is held fixed, so this measures the AI stage alone; first-round context (earlier recommendations hidden) as in the original generation.

controlled_invalid_recommendations.population: 10 controlled invalid recommendations (each a validated candidate with ONE injected fault)
controlled_invalid_recommendations.interpretation: Share of controlled invalid recommendations rejected by the deterministic validator/Policy checks; every scenario had a positive control proving the unmodified candidate validates.
controlled_invalid_recommendations.limitation: Scenarios are single-fault and written by the evaluator; they test rule coverage, not the AI, and are not adversarial or multi-fault.

consistency_runs.population: 26 IP-blocking steps in 30 repeated recommendation runs
consistency_runs.interpretation: IP-blocking steps aimed at the monitored endpoint's own address (172.19.0.5): TC-09#2 ACT-BLOCK-DESTINATION-IP. In the frozen runs such a step was the primary step of TC-07 (both runs) and occurred in TC-09 (Intervention Run).
consistency_runs.limitation: Supplementary deterministic observation outside the six compliance criteria; the evidence-support criterion cannot see the role of an IP.

human_and_policy_gates.population: 17 checks with the real use cases on the cloned database
human_and_policy_gates.interpretation: IR reject → PENDING_MANUAL_DECISION without execution and without closing the incident; manual decision only by IR with a note; wrong-role, AI and admin approvals denied; start before approval, re-hunt before completion and manual RESOLVED are blocked.
human_and_policy_gates.limitation: One incident and one reject path exercised; expected outcomes were defined before the checks ran.
